violation_type.title: Discipline - Individualized and Consistent for Each Child (26 TAC §746.2803(1))
violation_type.short_title: Discipline - Individualized and Consistent for Each Child
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during an investigation, a caregiver was using inappropriate discipline on select children in care.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained during an investigation, a caregiver was using inappropriate discipline on select children in care.

Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, the director was aware that a caregiver showed favoritism towards a child, and a child did not have the same consequences as the other children in a classroom.
Based on information received during the investigation inspection, there is sufficient evidence support the allegation of the child being inappropriately disciplined.
